title: Very Cheap and Disappointing…
text:
Very Cheap and Disappointing…. Packaging was ok, and seller got the package to me quickly.

Pros: Good designs on the magnets.

Cons: Made with a cheap plastic. Also uses really weak magnets. Can hold up one piece of paper but not much else. And heavy or strong closing of the refrigerator door, they fly off.

You get what you pay for with these. Cheap underwhelming magnets. Don’t waste your money.
